verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Ollama shipped a native desktop GUI app (macOS/Windows) that lets users chat with local models, with multimodal and Markdown support working as expected (ollama-comm-16, ollama-comm-18). However, the same evidence shows real caveats: no Linux support, no way to connect to a remote Ollama instance, and some developer pushback that building a GUI is outside Ollama's core mission (ollama-comm-17, ollama-comm-19, ollama-comm-20). Missing for 10: official first-party docs describing the GUI's features, cross-platform (Linux) parity, and independent hands-on reviews beyond a single HN thread.
